messages:
nora: Heads-up: customer-facing spike in embed split events this morning. Router traces show a lot of 2->4 splits on relatively small byte sizes.
sam: interesting. any tenant patterns?
youssef: yes, mostly a handful of ML teams sending mixed dims: shapes like [128,256] and [128,256,512] packed in one request. sample id t=nm22.
nora: exact header we received: `X-Embed-Dim-Hint: 128,256,512` + content-length 900KB. router log: `split_decision: heuristic_mixed_dims, target_shards=3`.
jia: that header is new from the internal SDK; it was supposed to be advisory only. looks like router is treating it as authoritative.
youssef: can we change decision matrix: if content-length < 1MB and max_dim <= 512 then prefer coalesce not split? current policy seems too eager.
sam: +1. a conservative fallback would reduce subrequest overhead for typical embeddings. propose override order: explicit tenant policy > size heuristic > hint.
jia: agreed. also we should record `split_reason_priority` metric so we can see what rule triggered the split.
console-bot: metric request received: add `embed.split.reason`, `embed.split.priority`, `embed.split.shards`, tags: tenant, model_family, sdk_version.
devops-bot: alert rule suggestion: fire if tenant split_rate > 1% sustained over 10m and split_success_rate < 95%.
youssef: operational concern: when splits happen we see extra KV cache invalidations in the runtime due to different request IDs. does split preserve cache keys? runtime team?
jia: runtime team (cc @runtime): runtime should pass through original `x-cache-key` header for subrequests; if absent, we'll inherit original request hash. otherwise we get cache churn.
nora: console UX ask: add a per-request "split waterfall" in the inspector showing subrequest sizes, estimated units, and any retries. product wants to show it in the usage tab.
sam: visualizing estimated extra cost is critical. runtime already computes `est_units`; expose `X-Embed-Est-Units` as an opt-in header for customers and keep `embed.split.added_units` as internal metric for billing analysis.
youssef: telemetry: collect histogram of `split_subbytes` and `split_latency_delta` (latency added due to splitting). want p50/p90/p99.
jia: implement a soft quota: per-tenant `split_units_budget` that prevents splits from doubling cost unexpectedly. when budget approaching, router should prefer rejection (with 429/413?) or fallback to lower-quality model.
devops-bot: best practice: 413 for malformed/unsupported payloads, 429 for budget/quota exceed. keep semantics consistent.
sam: SDK path: update Python/TS SDK to send `X-Embed-Dim-Hint` as `shape_hint` in JSON body unless user opts-in header mode. also have client-side preflight that warns when estimated split_units > threshold.
jia: rollout plan: patch router to treat hints advisory for 24h, emit `hint_overruled` tag when we ignore hint, and then enable strictness toggle per-tenant after 48h of telemetry.
console-bot: flag helper: `POST /flags {"flag":"split_hint_strict","pct":0, "tenants":["ml-team-a"]}`
youssef: testcases: mixed dims, nested arrays, and empty-ish hints "[]". parser should not crash on bad hints. add fuzz tests to CI.
nora: action items:
- sam: update metrics + alert rules (embed.split.*)
- jia: router policy changes (advisory -> conservative override) + preserve `x-cache-key` passthrough
- youssef: runtime to include `X-Embed-Est-Units` on split events and expose internal metric `embed.split.added_units`
- nora: console "split waterfall" mock + placement in usage tab
- sam & jia: SDK warning UX + preflight opt-in docs
- all: add fuzz parser tests
sam: target: metrics + parser hardening in 48h, router advisory change in canary same week, console feature in 2 weeks.
jia: I'll prepare a short runbook for tenants hitting split budget limits (how to dial shape hints vs request batching).
nora: thanks. if we can also attach one or two example request IDs in the console inspector that'd help SRE triage quickly.
youssef: I'll dump top 20 sample traces for the last 6h into the incident ticket.
nora: closing — will open PRs referencing issue #1424 and post links here. :raised_hands:
notes: No title field. Messages are a single string with each message prefixed by sender name as required.
